report:
Cranial MRI examination:
MRI Scanner: 1.5 Tesla.
Technique: Axial and sagittal T2, coronal T1, axial FLAIR.

Pituitary gland height is measured at 1 cm and contains a millimetric T2 hyperintense formation. Dynamic contrast-enhanced pituitary gland MRI is recommended.

The cystic variant of the pineal gland is observed. The sulcal width of the cerebral hemispheres appears compatible with the patient's age. Cerebellar folia are normal. Basal ganglia, thalami, internal and external capsules, mesencephalic structures, corpus callosum, and pericallosal areas are normal. Pons, medulla oblongata, medullary-cervical junction, and cerebellum are normal.

Lateral ventricles are asymmetric, with the right lateral ventricle being slightly ectatic compared to the left (variant). The ventricular system and cisterns are of normal width. Parasellar areas are normal.

Main cerebral vascular structures are normal. Arteries of the Circle of Willis, width and signal intensity of dural sinuses are normal. Thicknesses and signal intensities of the cisternal components of bilateral 5th, 7th, and 8th nerves are normal. Temporal bone, intra-orbital formations are normal. Mucosal thickening is present at the base of the left maxillary sinus. Aeration of other paranasal sinuses and craniofacial bone structures are normal. Pericranial soft tissues are normal.
